activityHint: Append-only. Every suspension, refund, plan change and support session is here with who did it.
activitySubtitle: Every change made from Helm, and every payment and fleet event
alertHint.fleetCrashLooping: The supervisor answers, the till does not — ours to fix.
alertHint.fleetOffline: Nothing heard from it at all, usually the client's power or network.
alertHint.noFirstSale: A week after install and the tills have not sold anything.
alertHint.promiseBroken: The promised day passed and the invoice is still open.
alertHint.trialEnding: Three days before, with no card on file.
chainBroken: The chain breaks at {{at}} — an entry was changed or removed.
chainOk: Log intact — {{count}} entries, each chained to the one before. Nobody, owners included, can edit or delete an entry.
chatHint: Add @octopos_helm_bot to the group, send /id, and paste the number it answers with.
crashHint: A restart that recovers on its own is not news.
disableHint: Disabling signs them out everywhere at once.
inviteHint: They get an email with a link to set a password. The link lasts 72 hours.
keyOnly: Offline alerts for key accounts only (everyone else is in the morning digest)
teamAlertsHint: Trouble posted to the team's Telegram group as it happens, with a link straight to the client or installation in Helm.
teamAlertsSubtitle: Installation and billing trouble posted to the team's Telegram group
teamHint: Everyone at Octopos who can sign in to Helm. What each person may do comes from their role.
teamSubtitle: Who works in Helm and what each role may do
